description: AS3 core API surface probes. Each probe runs in one exported frame script through the real compiler, exporter and Rust/WASM player. 'ok' = call/construction completed with documented argument types; 'eq:V' = exact documented constant value; 'notundefined' = readable member; 'function' = callable global; 'not:V' = result differs from the JavaScript default; controls prove that unknown members are not reported as present. Add a probe here before promoting a catalogue entry on presence evidence.
